description:
Of 2086 alt-text entries in `static/data/image-alt-text/en-US.json`, 754 (36 %) are raw Wikimedia `File:…` filenames and the remaining 1324 are non-descriptive labels (e.g. "NASA Images search result — chandra / 'chandra x-ray observatory'" or "Curated panel image — beidou slot 4"). Screen-reader users hear a filename or query term instead of a description. The `pickAlt()` function in `build-image-alt-baseline.ts` always falls through to `provenance.title` because `caption_short` and `description` exist on zero entries — the fallback is dead code in practice.

Expected: Every image served by the app has meaningful, descriptive alt-text derived from `image-vision.json`'s `subject` field (which exists on all 2233 entries with genuine vision-descriptions) or a reasonable synthesis, never a raw filename or search-query string. The 13 non-en-US locale files then cover the same paths for fully localized screen-reader output.

Acceptance criteria:
- No `en-US.json` entry has a value matching the `File:` prefix pattern or a bare extension-only string [code-invariant: A filename is not a description; screen-reader usability is the unconditional minimum.]
- Every `en-US.json` path that also exists in `image-vision.json` (at least 1891 of 2086 — confirmed by normalizing `.1x1.jpg`/`.webp` → `.jpg`) carries the `image-vision.json` entry's `subject` field value [repo-data: `static/data/image-vision.json` — all 2233 entries have a populated `subject` field (100%), e.g. subject: "A scale model of a Chinese navigation satellite displayed on a simulated lunar surface…"]
- A validator/audit script flags any `File:`-prefixed or bare-extension alt-text and fails preflight/validate-data [reporter: The issue explicitly requests "Add a validator/audit that flags `File:`-style / bare-`.jpg` alt-text as a quality gap"]
- The 13 locale overlay files contain entries for all paths in the fixed en-US file (i.e. the `translate-alt-text.mjs` script runs without the filename-skip filter and achieves 2086 entries per locale) [reporter: The issue states "re-run `scripts/translate-alt-text.mjs` (drop the filename skip → full coverage, option B) so all 14 locales carry real, translated alt-text"]

Domain facts:
- 195 alt-text entries have no corresponding entry in `image-vision.json` even after variant normalization — the specialist must decide how to handle these (strip `File:` prefix from the provenance title, or LLM-synthesize)
